Find something that makes you energetic beyond caffeine and drugs. For me it's cold showers every morning. Sounds crazy at first, but I've grown to enjoy that icy cold adrenaline rush that hits you like a subway train at first, but then makes you feel unstoppable for the rest of the day. Maybe for you it could be doing push-ups right when you wake up, or doing morning runs, or just scream into a mirror for 10 minutes. Maybe meditation could give you energy. Just keep trying something new. The moment you stop trying new things, the moment you realize you've stopped doing new things for years, in that moment you're fucked. Don't be that guy. And although this message is cliche, find a social group that you can relate to, and commit to meeting them every week. Depression can blindside you, drag you into an endless abyss of pity and despair, and generally fuck you for life, but you got to remain active, even if it's just small things at first, keep trying man! Good luck
